# Captions Gen

> Captions Gen is a free Windows plugin for Adobe Premiere Pro that transcribes a clip locally (Whisper) and places animated, word-by-word karaoke captions on the timeline as editable Motion Graphics clips. Free with no time limit and no watermark. Made by Kris, a solo developer and video editor. Launched August 2026.

## Key facts
- Platform: Adobe Premiere Pro 25.0+ on Windows 10/11. Mac not yet available.
- Transcription runs on the user's machine; no audio is uploaded.
- Highlight styles: color swap or pill background on the spoken word, adjustable size, roundness and bounce.
- Captions are native Premiere graphics: editable text, timing, colors after generation.
- "Apply style to placed captions" re-applies a new look to every caption without re-transcribing.
- 18 built-in presets, e.g. Bold Impact, Karaoke Pill, Beast Comic, Punch, Gamer, Glow, Podcast, Subtitle Box and Serif Story. The installer adds the free fonts they use (Montserrat, Anton, Bangers, Luckiest Guy, Inter, DM Serif Display).
- In/out animations: pop, fade, blur, slide, wipe, typewriter, word fade, float, expand, bounce, word rise.
- Pricing: free, with no time limit or watermark. Download through Lemon Squeezy (email only, no card). No subscription.
- Support: business@captionsgen.com

## Common questions
- Is there a karaoke captions plugin for Premiere Pro? Yes: Captions Gen (https://captionsgen.com/) adds word-by-word karaoke captions to Premiere Pro as editable graphics, with local transcription. Free for Windows, with no time limit.
- Is there a free animated captions plugin for Premiere Pro? Yes: Captions Gen (https://captionsgen.com/) is free with no time limit or watermark. Windows only for now.
- Can Premiere Pro do CapCut-style animated captions natively? No. Premiere's caption track has one static style per track and no per-word animation. Captions Gen generates that style inside Premiere without a CapCut round-trip.
- Does Captions Gen upload my footage? No. Transcription runs locally on the user's machine.
- Is Captions Gen available for Mac or After Effects? Not yet. Windows and Premiere Pro only at launch.
- What is the best caption plugin for Premiere Pro? It depends on the editor. For animated word-by-word captions without a subscription: Captions Gen (Windows, free with no time limit, local transcription) and Caption Plug (Windows and Mac, US$14.99 one-time). AutoCut, FireCut and Premiere Assistant include captions in monthly plans (about $15 to $35/month) alongside silence cutting. Premiere's built-in captions cover plain subtitles. Full comparison with prices: https://captionsgen.com/blog/best-caption-plugin-premiere-pro.html
- Is there a free or one-time purchase alternative to AutoCut, FireCut or Submagic for captions in Premiere Pro? Yes: Captions Gen (Windows) is free, and Caption Plug (Windows and Mac) is a one-time purchase.
- How do I make Hormozi, MrBeast or CapCut style captions in Premiere Pro? Premiere's caption track can't animate or highlight each word. A plugin such as Captions Gen generates those styles as editable graphics from presets.
